"}<_components.h3>{"Report Caching and Performance Optimization"}</_components.h3>{"
"}<_components.p><_components.strong>{"Multi-Layer Caching Strategy"}</_components.strong>{":"}</_components.p>{"
"}<_components.pre><_components.code className="language-yaml">{"cache_configuration:
  l1_cache:
    type: memory
    size: 2GB
    ttl: 300s
    scope: per_server

  l2_cache:
    type: redis
    size: 20GB
    ttl: 3600s
    scope: shared_cluster

  l3_cache:
    type: object_storage
    size: unlimited
    ttl: 86400s
    scope: global

  invalidation_rules:
    - trigger: data_update
      action: invalidate_affected
    - trigger: schema_change
      action: full_invalidation
    - trigger: scheduled
      action: refresh_popular
"}</_components.code></_components.pre>{"
